metadata.source: Synthetic CCPA-compliant practices based on enforcement guidance and best practices
metadata.methodology: Generated from regulatory requirements and enforcement case remediation
metadata.note: These cases represent compliant data handling practices derived from what companies successfully implemented after AG enforcement actions and CCPA regulatory requirements

cases.title: Online Retailer - Compliant Opt-Out with GPC Support
ccpa_compliant_practices: Honors Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals from browsers
Processes opt-out requests within 10 business days
Maintains service provider relationships with contractual CCPA restrictions
Clearly discloses third-party sharing in privacy policy

ci_parameters.subject: Customers
ci_parameters.consent: Explicit opt-out available; GPC signals honored

business_practices: Posted clear Do Not Sell My Personal Information link on homepage
Updated all service provider contracts with CCPA addendums
Implemented technology stack to detect and honor GPC
Trained staff on CCPA requirements
Established 30-day response timeline for consumer requests
cases.regulatory_reference: CCPA § 1798.100 (right to know), § 1798.105 (right to delete), § 1798.120 (right to opt-out)

cases.title: Retail Loyalty Program - Compliant Financial Incentive

Allowed consumers to withdraw from program at any time

ci_parameters.subject: Loyalty program participants
ci_parameters.consent: Express opt-in with material terms clearly disclosed

business_practices: Displayed Notice of Financial Incentive with program terms before enrollment
Used clear, non-technical language understandable to average consumer
Deep-linked online notices to ensure easy access
Tracked consumer consent for audit purposes
Provided simple opt-out mechanism for withdrawing from program
cases.regulatory_reference: CCPA § 1798.100 (notice requirements), California Civil Code § 1798.100(e) (financial incentive notices)
